Marissa / all —

High level recommendation (technical):
- Primary metrics: helpfulness (micro-F1 on oracle set) and hallucination rate (precision on hallucination labels).
- Initial tolerance: up to 3% relative degradation on helpfulness OR up to +2.5 percentage points on hallucination rate triggers investigation. Anything beyond both combined (e.g., >4% & >3pp) should be considered for immediate rollback.
- Stats: two-sided bootstrap with 95% CI on metric delta; require p < 0.05 for flagging unless the confidence interval is narrow (<1pp).
- Canary sizing: start at 5% traffic for 48 hours (min 2k prompts) for the pilot; expand to 20% for 7 days if stable.

Operational notes: ensure KV/prefix caching is aligned with production to avoid false positives; we should ask Storm to run the canary in the same traffic mode (live vs simulated). Also recommend keeping a snapshot (seed) of the promptset used in their eval for repro.

Link to internal templated thresholds: https://redwood.app/drive/ops/ab-thresholds-template

Karthik
Senior Staff Engineer, Serving Runtime

Quick operational additions:
- Early-warning signals: token latency spike (>25% above baseline), error-rate increase (>1pp), and sudden shift in top-k token distribution for protected intents. Any one of these + metric flag should trigger a canary pause.
- Rollback runbook: pause traffic to variant, switch routing to baseline within 10 minutes (automated route), snapshot logs and traces, notify stakeholders (Marissa, Karthik, Emma), then run targeted diagnostics (KV cache warmup check, quantization fallback).
- Escalation: if rollback fails to restore baseline within 2 hours, CS and infra on-call to engage.

I'll prepare a short runbook snippet and drop into the MAP.

Grace
Head of Reliability
Redwood Inference

Emma / Sam —

Thanks for the detailed report and for running the initial harness. Per internal triage, here's the agreed plan (summary to include in MAP-v1.docx attached):

- Acceptance thresholds: up to 3% relative degradation on helpfulness OR up to +2.5pp on hallucination rate will trigger investigation. Combined exceedance (example >4% and >3pp) triggers immediate rollback.
- Canary: 5% traffic for 48 hours (min 2k prompts), then 20% for 7 days if stable.
- Rollback SLA: automated pause + routing to baseline within 10 minutes of a confirmed trigger; full diagnostic and restore target within 2 hours.
- Owners: Marissa (sales lead / customer comms), Karthik (technical signoff / diagnostics), Grace (runbook + infra coordination), Emma (customer acceptance).
- Attachments: MAP-v1.docx (mutual action plan draft), customer_eval_report.pdf (customer data).

Next step: Emma, if this looks good I'll schedule a 30-min sync to lock MAP language and procurement items. Sam — finance/procurement please confirm this SLA language is acceptable.
